headline: Government announces success, Czarnek shows the bill. "You robbed Poles of 4 billion!" | Niezalezna.pl
summary: The Polish government is presenting lower fuel prices as a success. Przemysław Czarnek said drivers had previously paid far more at the pump, citing a 4 billion zloty figure.
why: Fuel prices feed directly into transport costs, inflation and consumer spending, and government measures on fuel can affect fiscal balances.
